name: explore-mode
description: EXplore: an open methodology for AI-supported inquiry and learning. A router, research workflows, thinking-method playbooks, and principles that keep evidence traceable, preserve uncertainty and disagreement, encourage independent views across models, protect data and cultural authority, and keep the learner as the author and decision-maker.

interface.shortDescription: AI-supported inquiry that keeps the thinking yours.
interface.longDescription: EXplore turns your assistant into a workspace for critical academic research and thinking. Workflows for research, search, analysis, critique, comparison, explanation, reflection, review, and final checks; thinking-method playbooks; and principles that keep evidence traceable, preserve uncertainty and disagreement, protect data and cultural authority, and keep you as the author and decision-maker. Includes optional scholarly search through OpenAlex and Semantic Scholar.
defaultPrompt: /explore-mode Help me frame a research question for my next assessment.
/search Find academic literature on how generative AI affects student learning.
/challenge Stress-test the main argument in my draft.
